claims.text: unsolicited modification of consensus rules without user demand or emergent consensus
claims.quote: this proposal represents an unsolicited modification of Bitcoin’s code and consensus rules. There is no clear user demand, no demonstrated market need, and no compelling application that justifies tak

claims.text: risk of contentious chain split without clear user demand and community consensus
claims.quote: Any proposed change should be weighed against the worst-case scenario: civil war or a chain split, which we’ve seen before.

claims.text: whether interpreter TODOs will be addressed
claims.quote: Are the TODOs going to be addressed here?
claims.status_note: author explained the TODO was premature and will remove the comment
claims.status_by_quote: In this case, likely not - @JeremyRubin was initially thinking that if there was some way we could rule out use of OP_CTV in the script about to be evaluated

claims.text: merging consensus rules into Core before rough community consensus sets a bad precedent and dictates rules
claims.quote: As this introduces a new consensus feature, it seems premature to merge this into Bitcoin Core until widespread consensus is reached among Bitcoin users to eventually activate this new feature in a so

claims.text: merging into Core acts as a step toward an activation attempt causing a potential chain split
claims.quote: Merging this pull request would be a step towards a second declared activation attempt for CTV and a potential chain split if there isn't community consensus.

claims.text: zero functional consensus test coverage without defining a regtest deployment
claims.quote: Currently there is zero consensus coverage at the functional level from what I can tell
claims.status_note: author added a regtest-only deployment commit

claims.text: cheap DoS vector where peers repeatedly broadcast max-block-weight CTV spends by tweaking 1 bit to force re-hashing
claims.quote: What prevents a peer to repeat broadcast of such ~MAX_BLOCK_WEIGHT tx CTV-spend to a target node ? Peer cost is just to tweaking some random 1-bit in the whole ~MAX_BLOCK_WEIGHT surface.
claims.status_note: author replied that standardness or PoW limits such spends and benchmarks show hashing is fast; reviewer pushed back but later Concept ACKed
claims.status_by_quote: The processing of such a CTV-spend is either limited by standardness or PoW; standardness prohibits the relay of a large, non-mined CTV transaction

claims.text: deploy CTV as a taproot op_success rather than legacy script
claims.quote: I think it would be valuable to have CTV rather as a taproot op_success.
claims.status_note: reviewer understood reasons for current design and later Concept ACKed
claims.status_by_quote: I would support a change of CTV to be Taproot only, but I also understand the concern of the champions with the realities of the bitcoin ecosystem

claims.text: replace SetHexDeprecated with uint256::FromHex in ctvhash_tests.cpp
claims.quote:
SetHexDeprecated() was recently removed in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32237

Possible resolution here:
claims.status_note: author incorporated the suggested uint256::FromHex test fix in a rebase

claims.text: CTV use cases in legacy script can be broken by abusing the 80k segwit block sigops limit
claims.quote: You can break some CTV use-cases by abusing the segwit block limits (i.e the 80k limit sigops).
claims.status_note: author replied this is a general legacy script limitation not specific to CTV; reviewer later accepted in Concept ACK
claims.status_by_quote: I don't see anything about your attack that's specific to CTV; e.g. your test script doesn't use the template hash or OP_NOP4 (OP_CTV).

claims.text: set m_bip119_ctv_ready to force instead of true and strip the superfluous if check
claims.quote: Shouldn't it be set to `force` instead of `true`? Makes this if completely superfluous
claims.status_note: author clarifies force is for segwit/taproot detection but agrees the if check can be stripped
claims.status_by_quote: no - `force` is simply the initial value for the segwit/taproot detection variables. Since there isn't a similar detection process for CTV, we must assume its cache prep is always required.

claims.text: whether this PR is a complete rewrite or a refactor of the original implementation from three years ago
claims.quote: clarify whether this pull request represents a complete rewrite or simply a refactor of the original implementation from three years ago

claims.text: require tx.version 3 or higher for CTV to avoid unneeded cache computations when CTV could not be active
claims.quote: Computation required by CTV ideally would not be carried out when CTV could not have been active. In this context the `tx.version` field is available.
